title: NIRAMAYA Health Insurance Scheme Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Health insurance support for eligible persons with specified disabilities, covering defined healthcare expenses subject to scheme terms.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Persons with eligible specified disabilities who satisfy NIRAMAYA enrolment and documentation requirements; disability certification and applicable age/enrolment rules apply.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under NIRAMAYA Health Insurance Scheme.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
